sloka: आपूर्यमाणम् शश्वत् च तेजो बल पराक्रमैः ।शशिनम् शुक्ल पक्ष आदौ वर्धमानम् इव श्रिया ॥४-५४-३॥
transliteration: āpūryamāṇam śaśvat ca tejo bala parākramaiḥ ।śaśinam śukla pakṣa ādau vardhamānam iva śriyā ॥4-54-3॥

translations.english: Hanuman proceeded to win over Angada, who was ever shining in strength and valour, who was growing in majesty constantly like the Moon in the bright fornight, whose intellectual prowess was equal to that of Brhaspati, who was equal to his father in valour and who was wellversed in all sastras. Angada was listening toTara like Indra listened to Sukra (preceptor of the demons).
translations.hindi: पञ्पञ्चाशः सगः ०१ तेखो, सुग्रीव ने तो अपने जीवित. ज्येष्ठ भ्राता की स्री को, जो छम से उसकी माता के समान है, अपनी स्री बना लिआ यह तो झद्‌'निन्द्य कमे हे
